## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2025!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish!

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**

**Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.**

**Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025.

**Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.name: FMC Tijuas II 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1bebd0144612f93a0dcf3a3fe3a47b3623ad1272/image.png)

Llega de nuevo a Tijuana el desafío más cerebral del speedcubing. FMC Tijuas II 2025 sube de nivel con la incorporación de Big Blind. Tres intentos, concentración total y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no gana quien corre más, sino quien piensa mejor.

¿Estás listo para enfrentarte al cubo sin verlo? ¿Estás listo para resolver con el menor número de movimientos?

**Esta competencia no incluye 3x3**

The most cerebral challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas II 2025 takes it further with the addition of Big Blind. Three attempts, total focus, and now blindfolded solving. Victory doesn’t go to the fastest, but to the smartest.

Are you ready to solve without seeing? Are you ready to move with precision?

**This competition does not include 3x3**

Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition!
We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach!

Welcome to Cape Cubes Winter 2025! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days, with a brand new format where we will do all the rounds of each event in a row, then move onto another event. Please look at the Schedule to see what this looks like, and when your events are due to begin.
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. On-the-spot registration will be accepted, but it is still a good idea to register and pay online. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.
​
**SPONSOR**
A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Cubestuff shop at the competition.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwODIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f6279e9aecc7732beb40546a8e15830a644dfd6/cubestufflogocolourv2-2048x800.png)

**VOLUNTEERING**
Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2025.

Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
